chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about a man, when he wants to perform istinja', how he should sit.
He said: “As he sits for relieving himself.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.لِلْغَائِطِ: for relieving oneself; specifically the posture used for defecation
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِيَ: to perform istinja', meaning to cleanse oneself after relieving oneself
key_terms.يَقْعُدُ: to sit; the bodily posture being asked about

ai.seo_question: How should a person sit when performing istinja' according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a brief legal instruction regarding the manner of sitting for istinja'. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that one should sit for cleansing in the same way that one sits for relieving oneself, indicating continuity in bodily etiquette related to taharah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.54 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about how a man should sit when he wants to perform istinja (cleaning oneself after using the toilet).
Imam (as) said: "As he would sit for relieving himself."
